resources.string: GameCube memory cards (MemoryCardA.USA.raw and the like), and if you choose so Dolphin\'s GCI folders (GC/USA/Card A, one file per save) and Wii saves. Each of them holds the saves of many games, so nothing here is synced until you choose a RomM game to keep it with. Dolphin writes a card file when GameCube slot A is set to a memory card, and a GCI folder when it is set to a GCI folder.
Not synced. Each GCI folder (GC/USA/Card A, GC/EUR/Card B…) holds the saves of many games, one file per save, so the folders are only synced once you choose a RomM game to keep them with.
Synced, one bundle per GCI folder, kept on RomM with %1$s. A bundle is synced as a whole: a newer one from the server never replaces this handheld\'s folder without asking you.

Not synced. The saves of Wii games in Dolphin\'s Wii folder (Wii/title/00010000) are synced as one bundle, only once you choose a RomM game to keep them with. Pick Dolphin\'s user folder (the one that holds GC and Wii) for this, not the GC folder.

Synced as one bundle, kept on RomM with %1$s. Only the games\' save data travels, never installed channels or Wii system files. A newer bundle from the server never replaces this handheld\'s Wii saves without asking you.
Also sync saves of disc channels
Channels some discs install (such as Wii Fit\'s) keep their saves in Wii/title/00010004. On: these saves travel as a second bundle, kept with the same game.
RomM keeps every save with a game. Search for the game to keep this folder\'s GCI folders with; any GameCube game on your RomM will do. Choose the same game on every handheld.
RomM keeps every save with a game. Search for the game to keep this folder\'s Wii saves with; any Wii game on your RomM will do. Choose the same game on every handheld.

Each bundle is synced as a whole (up to 64 MB and 4096 files). When it changed on both sides there is no merging: you choose one side, and the other side\'s copy is kept as a safety copy first. Close Dolphin before you sync.
%1$s: Wii saves were not synced. Pick Dolphin\'s user folder (the one that holds GC and Wii) instead of the GC folder.
%1$s: Dolphin has no Wii folder here yet. Start a Wii game in Dolphin once, then sync again.
%1$s was not synced: it is larger than %2$d MB or holds too many files.
